claim: Patchline generates release notes that are grounded in reproducible evidence rather than prose: the notes embed public proof deltas computed by diffing the previous release's gate set against the gates actually present in the repository today, contributor recognition drawn from gate-backed data, and an explicit known-limitations ledger. The worker derives the added-gate delta from the live scripts directory, so the notes can never advertise a capability whose gate is absent. The gate proves every advertised new proof maps to a real gate script and that the recognition and limitations sections are present and non-empty.
real_repo: patchline (self): proof delta computed against live scripts/*-gate.sh

recognition.highlight: Built the examples gallery and issue-to-artifact pipeline
